headline: Deadlocked pull request proposes 157 function matches, with no changes landed
summary: BlindFire1200 opened #50, proposing what the pull request describes as 157 function matches for Deadlocked. It has not merged, and no commits landed on main. A matched function compiles to exactly the same bytes as the original game.
highlights: For NTSC-U v1.00, #50 reports a proposed rise from 5.57% to 5.77% of code matched, with matched functions rising from 4,151 to 4,308 of 18,085.
For the PAL release, #50 reports a proposed rise from 5.95% to 6.14% of code matched, with matched functions rising from 4,553 to 4,696 of 18,113.
The proposal also retains C reconstructions for 33 near misses. It notes that 13 functions already had PAL-only C, so the releases do not gain the same number of matches (#50).
